summary.text: Amanda Millar is a Liberal candidate for Northern Victoria Region in the Legislative Council at the 2026 election, listed third on the joint Liberal and National ticket in Wikipedia's 2026 candidate list. She was a Liberal member for Northern Victoria from August 2013, when she filled the vacancy left by Donna Petrovich, until November 2014, after missing re-election from third place on the Coalition ticket. She later stood for Macedon in 2018 and was third on the Coalition's Northern Victoria ticket in 2022, losing both times. Before Parliament she was a manager at Jones Lang LaSalle and then worked in human resources at the University of Melbourne.

occupation.text: Strategist; formerly in human resources and employer-side workplace relations

prior_roles.organisation: Melbourne School of Engineering, University of Melbourne

priorities.text: A stronger voice for regional communities against what her party page calls a Melbourne-focused government agenda
Rebuilding the Liberal Party's strength in Northern Victoria

summary.text: Chris Lahy heads the Citizens Party ticket for Northern Victoria Region in the Legislative Council at the 2026 election, with Jeff Davy second. He lives at Lake Boga, works part time as a landscape gardener and cares for members of his family, and says his family was pushed out of dairy farming by water costs and deregulation. He has stood in the federal seat of Mallee at six elections since 2007, under the Citizens Electoral Council label until 2019 and as the Australian Citizens Party since 2022.

summary.text: Jaclyn Symes has represented Northern Victoria Region for Labor in the Legislative Council since 2014 and leads the government in the upper house. A lawyer who worked as an Australian Services Union industrial officer and as an adviser to Rob Hulls and Daniel Andrews, she has served as Attorney-General and, from December 2024 to August 2026, as Victoria's first female Treasurer. Since August 2026 she has held Energy and Resources, Environment, Climate Action and the State Electricity Commission, and she heads Labor's group (C) for Northern Victoria Region on the 2026 ballot paper.
